objective: Expose the exact lease failure layer and run a fixed macOS arm64 fork-to-exec repetition contract.
non_goals: Do not turn an evidence-determinism slice into an unreviewed lease product fix.
Do not change external-provider, Keychain or durable product-data behavior.
Do not claim a stable run unless the complete fixed repetition contract is recorded.
Do not redesign TaskStore ownership, SQLite schema, runtime authority, or persistence behavior.
invariant: A process-local owner-registry rejection and an OS owner-lock WouldBlock rejection remain distinguishable through the complete error source chain; a clean macOS arm64 parent executing the exact child helper observes the expected layer, and the fixed 20 focused plus two serial workspace repetitions contain no unexplained variation.
minimal_fix_contract: Add the smallest typed or structured failure-layer/source-chain evidence at the SqliteSlotOwnerLease acquisition boundary, assert the exact layer in the existing TaskStore fork-to-exec helper, and add one deterministic repository runner for the fixed repetition contract; do not change lease acquisition or release semantics unless the evidence-only change proves that a separate product fix is required.
old_path_deletion_contract: No retired product route is recreated. Replace any string-only lease-layer assertion made redundant by the structured failure-layer contract instead of retaining two competing evidence authorities.
acceptance_criteria: A same-process second owner attempt is identified as a process-registry rejection rather than an OS lock rejection.
The exec'd child while the clean parent owns the canonical slot is identified as an OS owner-lock WouldBlock rejection through the complete source chain.
After final parent-owner drop, the exact exec'd child reopens the same canonical slot with a different process epoch.
The evidence runner records macOS arm64, clean_parent=1, fork_to_exec=1, seed=N/A, process_model=one clean parent plus one exact exec'd child per focused case, and concurrency=1.
Focused 20 repetitions and two serial full-workspace repetitions have no unexplained variation; otherwise the blocker remains.
The canonical single-system guard, formatting, clippy, focused owner-lease contracts, and descriptor close-on-exec contract pass at the exact implementation head.
No external provider, Keychain operation, durable product-data write, new worktree, or sibling repository is used.
stop_conditions: Frozen source map or canonical owner is false.
A write is required outside allowed_touched_paths.
An expected-absent object would be recreated.
A required RED cannot be made to fail for the stated reason.
A closure-candidate proof has not failed before conditional implementation.
The same root cause has failed three implementation attempts.
The hard-stop size budget is exceeded; split the slice or stop for a successor Program.
External action or durable write needs authority not present in the packet.
The fixed harness cannot distinguish process-registry rejection from OS WouldBlock without changing lease ownership semantics.
Any repetition varies without a classified failure layer and preserved source chain.
ledger_update_contract: The Integrator records the exact W0-S2 packet, attempt, execution range, failure-layer evidence, repetition summary, residual UNKNOWN, and independently reviewed head. The Implementer does not change R4-FLAKY-001 closure or Wave outcome.
handoff_contract: Return exact changed paths and head SHA; the pre-fix RED proving failure-layer collapse; same-process registry and fork-to-exec OS-layer positive/counterfactual evidence; the structured 20+2 runner summary; raw failing iteration if any; single-system non-regression; and residual UNKNOWN without closure credit.
